text: {"lessons":["I took early profits in A, B, and E, but my account still fell from 101,235 to 88,319. I’ll judge my decisions by the whole portfolio, not just by the gains I’ve realized.","I sold some B at a 9% gain and more later at a 23.8% gain. I’ll use a quick gain as a reason to review the position, not as an automatic sell signal.","By the time I sold more A in Period 10, it was nearly 74% below my cost. I’ll review losing positions sooner and ask whether I’d buy them at today’s price instead of waiting to break even."]}
